text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonian Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski announced a cabinet reshuffle Tuesday evening. Parliament expected to endorse the new cabinet within the next few days.
- Revlolted depositors of bankrupt TAT financial institution from Bitola stoned the houses of Bitola Mayor Siljan Micevski and TAT owner Sonja Nikolovska. Police prevented further violence.
- Macedonian parliament will not discuss the government bill for compensation of depostiors of bankrupt TAT. Auditing of the financial institution expected to end shortly.
- Opposition IMRO-DPMNE starting a series of protest rallies in Ohrid on Wednesday. The central rally to be held on Saturday in Skopje.
- Television subscription fees to be included in the electricity bill starting from this month. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
